facts.fact: Zane 在被 Caroline 说服同进晚餐后骂自己"spineless fool"，并说相处越久他越想要她，every way。
facts.anchor: Spineless fool. It was the only way to describe myself after I’d agreed to dine with her tonight.

facts.fact: Zane 自我否定：曼哈顿最美的女人不会想要他；那是从事故（accident）结束之后的事，如今付钱与他上床的女人见到他的样子会惊恐躲避。
facts.anchor: The most beautiful woman in Manhattan, who’d willingly married the city’s most handsome man, would never desire me. Those days ended with the accident.

facts.fact: Fletcher 把 Caroline 安排在紧邻 Zane 卧室的 bedchamber，使他在此期间不得安宁。
facts.anchor: And Fletcher, that bastard, had arranged for Caroline to sleep in the bedchamber adjoining mine, ensuring I wouldn’t get a moment’s peace while here.

facts.fact: 晚上八点 Zane 在书房换上外套、领带与袖扣，准备赴宴，感觉自己像个开赴战场的士兵。
facts.anchor: At eight o’clock, I pushed back from my desk and pulled on my suit coat. Adjusted my tie and cuff links. I felt a little like a soldier headed into battle.

facts.fact: Zane 因一句"Mr. Bishop, may speak for himself"伤到 Caroline，立刻后悔，意识到自己像 Orson 那样苛刻贬低她。
facts.anchor: I regretted it the instant I said it. She withered, like a flower struggling to bloom in the most horrid conditions. Now I was acting like Orson, snapping and belittling her, causing her to doubt herself.

facts.fact: Caroline 遣散所有男仆，只因她发现 Zane 只要旁人在场就不肯吃喝。
facts.anchor: Because you won’t eat or drink with anyone else in the room.

facts.fact: Caroline 在晚餐上借酒劲数落 Orson 的控制：她必须被迫夸他的床上本事，并且事后要等他完事。
facts.anchor: Never being forced to praise him for his prowess in the bedroom? Never waiting with him after he finished so that—

facts.fact: Zane 从 Caroline 那句"等着他完事"里推断出 Orson 让她等待的真正原因是受孕（Conception）。
晚餐后 Caroline 问了一个尴尬问题，Zane 当场退席并连续三天躲着她；她的卧房与他相通，每晚能听见他动静。
facts.anchor: I hadn’t seen him in three days, though I knew he was still in the house somewhere.

facts.fact: 海边夜谈时 Zane 承认自己那晚确实在调情，并重复她的话"归咎于麦酒，翻篇过去"。
facts.anchor: Except I was flirting with you.

facts.fact: 章节末尾 Caroline 说出真心话：可惜没先遇见他，并踮脚吻了他的脸颊道晚安。
facts.anchor: I’m thinking it is a shame I didn’t meet you first.
